reviews.body: The new default exposes an incorrect rerank receipt. Please make the recorded settings match the request before switching the default.
The receipt fix addresses my earlier finding, but the new test fails with the locked dependencies.
The client selection fixes the previous test failure. There is one remaining check failure below.
The receipt, test-client, and formatting issues from my earlier reviews are addressed.

Reviewed the default and receipt changes at this head. The previously reported sampling-receipt, HTTP-client selection, and formatting issues are addressed; I found no blocking correctness issue. Focused local tests passed. This does not establish live Anthropic service availability.

review_comments.body: [P2] The new default makes rerank receipts report a setting that was not used. Enable Memory reranking and leave its model unset so it inherits this generation model: composition sets `temperature=0`, but the locked Pydantic AI 2.29.0 strips sampling parameters for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. I reproduced a successful request with no `temperature` in the outgoing body while `receipt_configuration()` reported `temperature: 0.0`. That value is included in `RerankConfig.effective_settings` and its digest, so the receipt misrepresents the executed configuration. Please normalize the recorded settings to what the Anthropic adapter actually sends (and cover the inherited-model path).

[P2] Please select the HTTP client based on what the installed Anthropic SDK accepts, not whether `httpx2` can be imported. With this PR's lockfile, `pydantic-ai-slim==2.29.0` installs `httpx2` through `genai-prices`, while `anthropic==0.117.0` requires an `httpx.AsyncClient`. Both parametrized cases therefore fail before making a request with `TypeError: Invalid http_client argument; Expected an instance of httpx.AsyncClient but got <class 'httpx2.AsyncClient'>`. I reproduced both failures using the locked versions. This also fails the unit test job in the normal development environment.

[P2] Please format this test before merging: `ruff format --check tests/builtin/inference/test_pydantic_ai.py` fails on this multiline `AnthropicModel` call with the repository's pinned Ruff 0.15.7. The CI preflight runs `make check`, which runs the `ruff-format` pre-commit hook, so it will fail until this file is formatted.

Thanks, good catch. Pushed a commit on top: `_receipt_model_settings` now drops `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` from the recorded settings when the model profile sets `anthropic_disallows_sampling_settings`, the same set the Anthropic adapter strips before the request. So for `claude-sonnet-5-5` the rerank receipt (and its `effective_settings` digest) no longer reports `temperature: 0.0`, while models that still accept sampling settings, such as `claude-sonnet-4-5`, keep recording it.

Tests: a unit case for `claude-sonnet-5-5` vs `claude-sonnet-4-5` in `tests/builtin/inference/test_pydantic_ai.py`, and an e2e case in `tests/e2e/test_prepared_context_receipt.py` where reranking is enabled with no model set, so it inherits the generation model, and the receipt has no sampling settings. Both fail without the change.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

Thanks, you're right. Pushed a commit on top: the receipt test now takes the HTTP library from the installed Anthropic SDK (`anthropic._base_client` imports `httpx` up to the 0.x releases and `httpx2` in the newer ones) instead of checking whether `httpx2` is importable. With the locked versions (`anthropic==0.117.0`, `httpx2` pulled in by `genai-prices`), `tests/builtin/inference/test_pydantic_ai.py` passes: 49 tests, and both parametrized cases you mentioned failed before the change.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
